newsitem.title: UK: Tanker rates seen rising - Chevron's Moore.
newsitem.headline: Tanker rates seen rising - Chevron's Moore.

text.p: Tanker rates are likely to firm over the next few years as a surplus of tonnage is cut down with increased scrapping, Chevron Shipping Co president Tom Moore said on Thursday.

"We see the market firming over the next few years...The surplus of tonnage is down, so the market can easily accommodate the surplus," Moore added. He declined to give any figurs for the expected rise.
